items.text: Dawn: Fushimi Inari
Check out of HOTEL TAVINOS with small bags only (key card opens the door before 6:00). Suitcases already sent to Osaka.
Walk to Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojō Stn.
Keihan semi-express Kiyomizu-Gojō → Fushimi-Inari, then 5 min walk to the main gate.
Sunrise ~6:15. Senbon Torii up to the Yotsutsuji lookout (40–50 min) and a bit beyond, then back down. The full summit loop doesn't fit. 📿 stamp if the office is open.
JR Nara Line Inari → Uji (station opposite the main gate). Earlier option 8:02 → 8:19.
Morning: Uji
JR Uji → Byōdō-in along the tea-shop street.
Byōdō-in (opens 8:45, ¥700; Phoenix Hall interior +¥300, slots from 9:30). Hōshōkan museum. Hold up a 10-yen coin.
Across the river by Asagiri bridge; free, opens 9:00.
Be at Taihō-an 10:50 (~5 min from Byōdō-in). Usucha tea ceremony 11:00. Show the QR at reception.
Back to JR Uji; buy onigiri or a bento on the way (Nakamura Tōkichi is 1 min from the station).
Afternoon: Uji → Yoshino
JR Nara Line Uji → Nara (arr. 12:21), change (6 min).
JR Nara → Ōji (arr. 12:45), change: 19 min wait, eat here.
JR Wakayama Line Ōji → Yoshinoguchi (arr. 13:42). The line showed an operations notice: check on the day. Change to Kintetsu (3 min).
Kintetsu Yoshino Line Yoshinoguchi → Yoshino (arr. 14:21). Uji → Yoshino ¥1,630 pp in total (JR ¥1,170 + Kintetsu ¥460).
Chikurinin free shuttle from Yoshino Station (confirmed by the inn).
Arrive at Chikurinin; check-in from 15:00, so leave the small bags (confirmed by the inn). Choose the private-bath slot and the dinner time at check-in.
Yoshino
Ridge street, autumn colour. Sunset ~16:55. Yoshimizu Shrine and Zaō-dō are tomorrow morning; Takagiyama removed (~90 min on foot).
Private bath (kashikiri, ¥3,300 per 50 min; available per the inn), slot chosen at check-in. Public bath 16:00–22:00 and 6:00–9:00.
Dinner at Chikurinin, time chosen at check-in (from 18:00). Only served if checked in by 19:30.
Skipped: K24 Tōfuku-ji (doesn't fit the 14:30 shuttle).
